title: Implement first-party app authentication for Microsoft Fabric Export
summary: Microsoft Fabric Export now uses first-party app authentication instead of user-based credentials, improving security and removing the need for user intervention in credential setup.
key_points: Replaces user-based credential management with first-party app authentication
Adds environment cleanup subscription to handle credential removal
Updates setup wizard and admin pages to work with the new authentication model
Expands test coverage for platform credential and authentication scenarios
Maintains backward compatibility while improving security posture
